phrases.en: I need to see a doctor.
I don't have an appointment.
My insurance card is here.
How long until I'm seen?

dialogue.en: Hi, I need to see a doctor.
Do you have an appointment?
No, I don't have an appointment.
Fill out this form, please.
Okay. How long is the wait?
Around half an hour.

phrases.en: I'm visiting from China. Can I see a doctor without insurance?
phrases.zh: 我从中国来。没有保险能看医生吗？

phrases.en: I have travel insurance. Do you accept it?
phrases.zh: 我有旅行保险。你们接受吗？

phrases.en: Can I pay out of pocket?
Is there a walk-in clinic nearby?
Can I get a receipt for my insurance claim?
phrases.zh: 能给我收据用于保险理赔吗？

dialogue.en: I'm visiting from China. Can I see a doctor without insurance?
dialogue.zh: 我从中国来。没有保险能看医生吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, but you'll pay at the time of service.
I have travel insurance. Do you accept it?
dialogue.zh: 我有旅行保险。你们接受吗？

dialogue.en: We don't bill international insurance directly.
dialogue.zh: 我们不直接结算国际保险。

dialogue.en: Can I pay out of pocket?
Yes, and we'll give you a detailed receipt.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我们给您明细收据。

dialogue.en: Good. Is there a walk-in clinic nearby?
dialogue.zh: 好。附近有免预约诊所吗？

dialogue.en: We take walk-ins until five.
dialogue.zh: 我们五点前接受免预约。

dialogue.en: Great. Can I get a receipt for my insurance claim?
dialogue.zh: 好。能给我收据用于保险理赔吗？

dialogue.en: It will be ready at checkout.

phrases.en: I have a chronic condition and need a refill. Can I see a doctor today?
phrases.zh: 我有慢性病，需要续药。今天能看医生吗？

phrases.en: My travel insurance requires pre-authorization. Can you call them?
phrases.zh: 我的旅行保险需要预授权。能打电话吗？

phrases.en: I need medical records in English for my insurance. Can you provide them?
phrases.zh: 我需要英文病历用于保险。能提供吗？

phrases.en: Is there a specialist I can see without a referral?
phrases.zh: 有不需转诊就能看的专科医生吗？

phrases.en: Can you recommend a pharmacy that's open late?
phrases.zh: 能推荐开到很晚的药店吗？

dialogue.en: I have a chronic condition and need a refill. Can I see a doctor today?
dialogue.zh: 我有慢性病，需要续药。今天能看医生吗？

dialogue.en: We can fit you in at 3:30.
Thank you. My travel insurance requires pre-authorization. Can you call them?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我的旅行保险需要预授权。能打电话吗？

dialogue.en: Bring the number and we'll call together.
dialogue.zh: 把号码带来，我们一起打。

dialogue.en: I need medical records in English for my insurance. Can you provide them?
dialogue.zh: 我需要英文病历用于保险。能提供吗？

dialogue.en: The doctor can print a summary after your visit.
dialogue.zh: 医生就诊后可以打印摘要。

dialogue.en: Good. Is there a specialist I can see without a referral?
dialogue.zh: 好。有不需转诊就能看的专科医生吗？

dialogue.en: Not in this clinic, but the urgent care center takes walk-ins.
dialogue.zh: 本诊所没有，但急诊中心接受免预约。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can you recommend a pharmacy that's open late?
dialogue.zh: 好。能推荐开到很晚的药店吗？

dialogue.en: The one on Main Street is open until midnight.

phrases.en: I have a fever.
My stomach hurts.
I've been vomiting.
I need medicine.

dialogue.en: What seems to be the problem?
I have a fever. My stomach hurts.
How long have you felt this way?
Since last night. I've been vomiting.
dialogue.zh: 从昨晚开始。我一直在吐。

dialogue.en: Any other symptoms?
No. I need medicine.

phrases.en: I've had a sore throat and a cough for four days.
I can't take penicillin.
I'm taking blood pressure medication.
Do I need a test?
Can I get a doctor's note for work?

dialogue.en: I've had a sore throat and a cough for four days.
Any fever or body aches?
A low fever last night. I can't take penicillin.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚低烧。我不能用青霉素。

dialogue.en: Noted. Are you taking any medication?
Yes, for blood pressure. I'm taking blood pressure medication.
I'll prescribe something that won't interact.
dialogue.zh: 我开一种不会相互作用的药。

dialogue.en: Good. Do I need a test?
A rapid strep test will tell us.
dialogue.zh: 快速链球菌检测能确定。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I get a doctor's note for work?
I'll print one before you leave.

phrases.en: The pain started in my lower right abdomen and moved to my back.
phrases.zh: 疼痛从右下腹开始，转移到背部。

phrases.en: I have a history of asthma and I'm wheezing.
I'm on a blood thinner. Is it safe to take ibuprofen?
phrases.zh: 我在吃抗凝药。能吃布洛芬吗？

phrases.en: I think I need stitches. Can you check this cut?
phrases.zh: 我觉得需要缝针。能看看这个伤口吗？

phrases.en: I'm pregnant. Which tests are safe?
phrases.zh: 我怀孕了。哪些检查安全？

dialogue.en: The pain started in my lower right abdomen and moved to my back.
dialogue.zh: 疼痛从右下腹开始，转移到背部。

dialogue.en: How bad is it on a scale of one to ten?
About seven. I have a history of asthma and I'm wheezing.
dialogue.zh: 大约七。我有哮喘史，现在在喘。

dialogue.en: I'll check your breathing and order a scan.
I'm on a blood thinner. Is it safe to take ibuprofen?
dialogue.zh: 我在吃抗凝药。能吃布洛芬吗？

dialogue.en: No, avoid ibuprofen with your medication.
dialogue.zh: 不能，吃你的药期间避免布洛芬。

dialogue.en: Okay. I think I need stitches. Can you check this cut?
dialogue.zh: 好。我觉得需要缝针。能看看这个伤口吗？

dialogue.en: It's deep enough for stitches. I'll numb it first.
I'm pregnant. Which tests are safe?
dialogue.zh: 我怀孕了。哪些检查安全？

dialogue.en: We'll avoid X-rays and use an ultrasound instead.
dialogue.zh: 我们会避免 X 光，改用超声波。

phrases.en: Do you take my insurance?
How much will it cost?
Do you accept cards?
Can I have a receipt?

dialogue.en: Your insurance card, please.
Here it is. Do you take my insurance?
dialogue.zh: 在这里。你们收我的保险吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, but there's a co-pay.
How much will it cost?
Forty dollars today.
Okay. Do you accept cards?

phrases.en: My insurance covers urgent care. Is this visit covered?
phrases.zh: 我的保险覆盖急诊。这次就诊覆盖吗？

phrases.en: Can you submit the claim for me?
What's the deductible?
Can I get an itemized bill?
Will I need to pay upfront?

dialogue.en: My insurance covers urgent care. Is this visit covered?
dialogue.zh: 我的保险覆盖急诊。这次就诊覆盖吗？

dialogue.en: Let me check your plan.
Can you submit the claim for me?
We can submit it electronically.
What's the deductible?
Two hundred dollars, but you've met half.
dialogue.zh: 两百美元，但您已经用了一半。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I get an itemized bill?
We'll print it at checkout.
Good. Will I need to pay upfront?
Only the co-pay today.

phrases.en: My travel insurance requires a diagnosis code on the receipt. Can you include it?
phrases.zh: 我的旅行保险要求收据上有诊断代码。能加上吗？

phrases.en: I was told the visit was covered, but I received a bill. Can you review the claim?
phrases.zh: 有人说这次就诊覆盖，但我收到账单。能核对理赔吗？

phrases.en: Can you provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement?
phrases.zh: 能提供 superbill 用于网络外报销吗？

phrases.en: I need to pay in installments. Is that possible?
phrases.zh: 我需要分期付款。可以吗？

phrases.en: Can you email the invoice to my insurer directly?
phrases.zh: 能把发票直接发给我保险公司吗？

dialogue.en: My travel insurance requires a diagnosis code on the receipt. Can you include it?
dialogue.zh: 我的旅行保险要求收据上有诊断代码。能加上吗？

dialogue.en: I'll add the code before I print it.
Thank you. I was told the visit was covered, but I received a bill. Can you review the claim?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。有人说这次就诊覆盖，但我收到账单。能核对理赔吗？

dialogue.en: I'll compare the claim with your plan.
dialogue.zh: 我把理赔和您的计划对比。

dialogue.en: Can you provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement?
dialogue.zh: 能提供 superbill 用于网络外报销吗？

dialogue.en: I'll prepare one today.
Good. I need to pay in installments. Is that possible?
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要分期付款。可以吗？

dialogue.en: We can set up a payment plan.
Great. Can you email the invoice to my insurer directly?
dialogue.zh: 好。能把发票直接发给我保险公司吗？

dialogue.en: Send me the claims address.

phrases.en: I need help now.
It's an emergency.
I can't breathe well.
Where is the ER?

dialogue.en: I need help now. It's an emergency.
dialogue.zh: 我现在需要帮助。这是急诊。

dialogue.en: What's wrong?
I can't breathe well.
Come with me. We'll check you in.
Where is the ER?
You're in the right place. A doctor will see you.
dialogue.zh: 您来对地方了。医生会来看您。

phrases.en: I cut my hand and it won't stop bleeding.
I think I broke my ankle.
I have chest pain.
How long will the wait be?
Can someone call my family?
phrases.zh: 能有人给我家人打电话吗？

dialogue.en: I cut my hand and it won't stop bleeding.
Press here. We'll take you back now.
dialogue.zh: 按住这里。我们马上带您进去。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I think I broke my ankle.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我觉得脚踝骨折了。

dialogue.en: Which ankle?
The left one. I have chest pain, too.
Chest pain goes first. Come with me.
Okay. How long will the wait be?
The doctor will see you in a few minutes.
Good. Can someone call my family?
dialogue.zh: 好。能有人给我家人打电话吗？

dialogue.en: Give me the number and I'll call.

phrases.en: I'm having trouble breathing and my lips are turning blue.
I have a severe allergic reaction. Do you have an EpiPen?
phrases.zh: 我严重过敏。有肾上腺素笔吗？

phrases.en: I take a blood thinner. The cut won't stop bleeding.
phrases.zh: 我在吃抗凝药。伤口一直流血。

phrases.en: I'm diabetic and my blood sugar is very low.
I need an interpreter. Is one available?

dialogue.en: I'm having trouble breathing and my lips are turning blue.
We're taking you to a room now. Does your throat feel tight?
dialogue.zh: 马上带您进房间。喉咙紧吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. I have a severe allergic reaction. Do you have an EpiPen?
dialogue.zh: 紧。我严重过敏。有肾上腺素笔吗？

dialogue.en: We have epinephrine. We'll give it now.
dialogue.zh: 有肾上腺素。现在给您用。

dialogue.en: I take a blood thinner. The cut won't stop bleeding.
dialogue.zh: 我在吃抗凝药。伤口一直流血。

dialogue.en: Which blood thinner?
Eliquis. I'm diabetic and my blood sugar is very low.
dialogue.zh: 艾乐妥。我有糖尿病，血糖很低。

dialogue.en: We'll check your glucose and start an IV.
dialogue.zh: 我们查血糖并开始输液。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I need an interpreter. Is one available?
I'll request a Mandarin interpreter now.
dialogue.zh: 我现在申请普通话翻译。
